experiments_without_findings: Code read: machine::collect_mcycle_root_hashes, collect_mcycle_bundle, collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes, collect_uarch_cycle_bundle, append_uarch_reset_root_hash, append_revert_uarch_tail_period (src/machine.cpp 2416-3033), collect-mcycle-hashes-state-access.hpp, collect-uarch-cycle-hashes-state-access.hpp, interpret() break-reason order (interpret.cpp 6403-6467), get_state_break_reason, is_rejected_manual_yield, send_cmio_response no-op paths, the C/Lua/JSON-RPC wrappers and JSON (de)serialization of partial_bundle, mcycle_root_hashes and uarch_cycle_root_hashes, and the cm.h and manual (doc/README.md 5646-5693) contracts. No contract violation found. Checked by hand among others: fixed point reached exactly at mcycle_end or at a sampling point (no duplicate leaf, interpret reports overflow/halt/yield before reached_target), imcyclemax reached exactly at a target, automatic yield exactly on a sampling point or bundle end, the pad/final-bundle structure when execution exactly fills the bundles before the final one (count matches the documented [exec bundles, halt-pad bundle, final bundle] layout), the revert tail of maximal length 2^20, phase arithmetic with period 2^63, saturating bundle bounds near 2^64.

Worst-case uarch cycles per mcycle (uncovered R1 R5 item): bare-metal guest heavy.S (soft-float fdiv/fsqrt/fma on subnormals, NaNs, inf; div/rem/mulh*; sfence.vma; satp writes under MPRV with Sv48 4-level walks and A/D updates; misaligned page-crossing loads and stores; LR/SC/AMO; ecall/ebreak/illegal traps). Maximum 17,633 uarch cycles in one mcycle (csrw satp / sfence.vma TLB flush), about 60x below UARCH_CYCLE_MAX = 2^20-1; soft-float ops stay near 12k. collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes halt/reset hashes equal run_uarch+get_root_hash and reset_uarch+get_root_hash on all 819 mcycles.

Differential fuzz fuzz.lua with command-driven bare-metal guest rg.c (automatic yields with odd reason 7 and progress reason, busy loops dirtying pages, console putchar, sfence.vma; inputs end by accept, reject, halt, manual yield with odd reason 9, exception, or spin to the saturated imcyclemax): 78 trials (seed 7) plus 60 trials with the template at mcycle 2^64-3,023,081 so that delivery saturates imcyclemax and 'S' guests reach mcycle 2^64-1, plus 15 trials through JSON-RPC (spawned cartesi-jsonrpc-machine). Per trial: reference hashes per mcycle (collect with period 1, spot-checked against native run + get_root_hash with the revert rule); 6 collect_mcycle_root_hashes runs in random parts (log2 period 0-7, random phase, bundles 2^0-2^4, partial bundles carried, calls with mcycle_end = current mcycle, past the fixed point, mid-period) compared entry by entry, and final_bundle_sibling_hashes verified to prove the stated leaf; 4 collect_mcycle_bundle runs (random offsets incl. past the fixed point); 2 collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes runs at random mcycles incl. the rejecting / halting / yielding mcycle and the fixed point itself (spot-checked against run_uarch(k)+get_root_hash, halt and reset hashes, tail substitution) and rebuilt under bundles 2^0..2^20, plus collect_uarch_cycle_bundle at random offsets incl. the final one. Zero mismatches (the one reported failure was the harness passing mcycle+1 = 0 at mcycle 2^64-1).

Linux differential linux.lua on the valid-template echo app (timer interrupts, page faults, TLB activity, automatic yields of notice/report): 9 windows of 10^5-10^6 mcycles at random offsets of a 56M-mcycle input; collect_mcycle_root_hashes with period 1 vs native run + get_root_hash at random points and at RTC tick boundaries (8192) +-1; collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes single mcycles interleaved with native runs on the same machine (incl. tick boundaries) vs the collected mcycle hashes; final state after interleaving vs uninterrupted. Zero mismatches.

CLI differential (support component): cartesi-machine --mcycle-computation-hash vs an independent reference epoch tree (2^24 slots x 2^(48-p) leaves, fixed-point and empty-slot padding, rejection exception) for 7 input sequences (reject in the middle, reject last, two consecutive rejects, halt then no-op input, odd manual yield, exception, automatic yields), p in {0,3,4,7,10,12}, bundles 0-7; and --uarch-cycle-computation-hash vs a reference period tree for the stopping period and the period after it for accept, halt, exception, odd manual yield and reject, bundles 0-19. All equal.
not_covered: Interrupt-heavy bare-metal scenarios (timer interrupt pending at the exact mcycle of an automatic yield, a fixed point or a sampling point; PLIC external interrupts) were exercised only through the Linux windows, not with a targeted guest.

Stale-TLB scenarios built on purpose (PTE changed without sfence.vma, then mixing native collection and uarch collection on the same machine) were only exercised incidentally by Linux; no targeted bare-metal test.
collect_mcycle_root_hashes with console output to_buffer (break_reason console_output at a sampling point or bundle end) was not run; the fuzz used the default console runtime config.

Bundle parameters at their maxima were not run dynamically for the mcycle builders (log2 period + log2 bundle close to 63, previous_partial_bundle with leaf counts near 2^53 through JSON); only reasoned (trusted-caller parameters).

Rejection at the exact mcycle imcyclemax (rejecting yield on the last budget cycle) and rejection at mcycle 2^64-1 were not generated by the fuzz (the saturated runs ended by spin, accept, halt, odd yield or exception before the end); the project's own spec covers the last-budget-cycle reject.

Linux windows covered only the echo app with a normal payload; the reject path, halts and imcyclemax under Linux were not run; uarch spot checks on Linux compared only reset hashes, not per-uarch-cycle hashes.

Cost bounds of the builders (R12, e.g. collect_uarch over a full 2^18-mcycle period of the released Dave geometry) were not measured beyond noting about 21 us per sampled mcycle with period 1 on Linux; earlier candidates (R1-R8-3, R1-A7-1) cover cost.
Fault injection (exceptions inside the builders) and persistence of builder state across store/load were not tested (R1-O2-3 and R3-VARDIRTY cover that area).
The PRT player's use of the builders (prt.lua forests, bundle opening) and the Dave/sling node commitment builders were not examined.
